settings.agents.args_label: Added every time this agent starts, e.g. --dangerously-skip-permissions. Leave empty for none.
settings.agents.args_unbalanced: Close the quote or remove the trailing backslash.
settings.agents.install_confirm_body:
Diri runs its official installer in a new terminal tab:

{command}{requirement}
settings.agents.installing_detail: Installing in its own tab. Diri notices when it finishes.
settings.agents.name_sessions_detail: Agents name the session after the task they're working on. A name you give always wins. Changes apply to new agent sessions.
settings.agents.not_detected: Agent detection has not run for this host.
settings.agents.path_hint: Found through your shell's PATH. Use Add… for an agent installed somewhere else.
settings.computer.accessibility_detail: Lets agents click and type in apps.
settings.computer.allow_detail: Allow Diri both below so agents can see and control the apps they open.
settings.computer.detail: Agents open their own app windows and work in the background, each with its own cursor.
settings.computer.engine_unavailable: Diri couldn't check computer use. Restart Diri and try again.
settings.computer.guide_accessibility: Drag {app} to the list above to allow Accessibility
settings.computer.guide_screen_recording: Drag {app} to the list above to allow Screen Recording
settings.computer.log_detail: What setup printed, for a bug report.
settings.computer.ready_detail: Agents can use apps on this Mac. Cua Driver {version}.
settings.computer.screen_recording_detai: Lets agents see the windows they work in.
settings.computer.title: Let agents use apps
settings.computer.update_detail: Cua Driver {installed} is installed; Diri needs {tested}.
settings.schedules.allow_wake: Allow diri to wake the Mac
settings.schedules.asleep_section: When the Mac is asleep or restarts
settings.schedules.catch_up_detail: If the Mac is asleep or diri isn't open at that time, run once when it's back, up to 12 hours late.
settings.schedules.error_folder: Choose a folder for the agent to work in.
settings.schedules.error_prompt: Write what the agent should do.
settings.schedules.helper_detail: A small helper that can only schedule wakes for your runs and put the Mac back to sleep after them. Needs a one-time administrator approval.
settings.schedules.helper_requires_appro: Waiting for approval: switch on diri in System Settings > General > Login Items. macOS asks for an administrator password once.
settings.schedules.helper_unreachable: Approved, but diri couldn't reach it: {error}
settings.schedules.intro: Start an agent at a set time. Later runs continue in the same tab until you close it. You can also ask any agent in diri, for example “every weekday at 9, triage new issues”.
settings.schedules.keep_awake_detail: Prevent idle sleep from 10 minutes before each run until it finishes. Closing the lid still sleeps.
settings.schedules.login_detail: Schedules run only while diri is open. Opening at login lets a run missed during a restart catch up.
settings.schedules.login_requires_approv: Allow diri in System Settings > General > Login Items.
settings.schedules.login_unavailable_pla: Login items aren't available on this platform.
settings.schedules.once_passed: That one-time run has passed. Create a new schedule.
settings.schedules.only_in_applications: Only available when diri is installed in Applications.
settings.schedules.run_missed: Skipped the run due {due}{reason}: too late to catch up{folded}
settings.schedules.run_summary_awake: Started by the schedule “{title}”, due {due}. The Mac was already awake.
settings.schedules.run_summary_woke: Started by the schedule “{title}”, due {due}. diri woke the Mac for this run and lets it sleep again when the agent finishes.
settings.schedules.wake_mac_detail: Wake a sleeping Mac 2 minutes before, keep it awake while the agent works, then let it sleep again. The lid must be open.
settings.schedules.wake_macos_only: Waking the Mac is only available on macOS.
settings.schedules.wake_needs_helper: Turn on “Allow diri to wake the Mac” below first, or this schedule can't wake it.
settings.skills.intro: Browse skills on {machine} and in the current local project.
settings.skills.none_found: No skills found. Add a SKILL.md folder to your agent’s skills directory, then refresh.
settings.skills.plugin_note: Plugin entries include cached versions. Each agent controls which skills are active.
settings.skills.read_failed: This skill could not be read. Refresh the catalogue if it was moved or removed.
settings.skills.select_project: Select a local project to browse its skills.
settings.skills.unreadable: {count} files or folders could not be read.
